item: Row 107: a short masked query value no longer survives in an exception's text
summary: query_secrets hands the scrub each masked value in its context (name=value, behind ? & ;) as well as alone, so a value under the 4-character floor leaves requests' 'url: /rss?pin=123' with its name and the sentence is kept; a query too short for any context (?7) is handed over short so the scrub withholds that text. Closes the short-value limit stated in query_secrets' docstring (R734 build); R734's own stated limit (two addresses differing only in a masked value are written the same) stands. The first security read also found a pre-existing leak: a lower-case escape beside a stray % was re-quoted by requests as %252F, a spelling _written_forms never made; fixed by changing the escapes' case before quoting.
